title: Apple Event Announced for September 9: 'Surprise and Shine'
author: Juli Clover
content:
Apple plans to hold its annual iPhone-centric event on Wednesday, September 9 at the Apple Park campus in Cupertino, California. The event will begin at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time, with select members of the media invited to attend.
The September 2026 iPhone event will see Apple announce the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the foldable iPhone, which could be called the iPhone Ultra. There won't be an iPhone 18 this year because Apple is waiting until spring 2027 to launch the more affordable models.
All three new iPhones will use Apple's latest A20 Pro chip built on a 2nm process for speed and efficiency improvements. The iPhone 18 Pro models could get an upgraded variable aperture rear camera, but will otherwise be similar to the iPhone 17 Pro models. We are expecting price increases due to ongoing memory shortages.
Surprise and shine! It's almost time for the #AppleEvent, on Wednesday, September 9! pic.twitter.com/SLkIcNmLwP — Greg Joswiak (@gregjoz) August 26, 2026
The foldable iPhone will be Apple's first new form factor since the launch of the 2017 iPhone X. It will have a book-like design, and it will be around 5.5 inches when closed and 7.6 inches when open. It is wider than it is tall, and will be similar to using an iPad when unfolded. Since the foldable iPhone is so thin, there are compromises, and it will use Touch ID instead of Face ID and it won't have a telephoto camera.
Apple is also going to introduce the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, plus there's a possibility we'll see new smart home devices, including the long-rumored home hub, a new Apple TV 4K, and an updated HomePod mini.
Along with new hardware, Apple will give us launch dates for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, and other upcoming software updates.
Apple plans to stream the fall event live on its website, on YouTube, and through the Apple TV app. For those unable to watch, MacRumors will be providing full event coverage on MacRumors.com and the MacRumorsLive Twitter account.
summary: Apple has announced its upcoming event for September 9, 2026, at the Apple Park campus, where it plans to unveil new hardware including the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and its first foldable iPhone. The company will also introduce the Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, potential smart home devices, and software launch dates. The event will be streamed live across multiple platforms.
key_points: Apple's event will take place on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time.
The lineup features the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and a book-style foldable iPhone, with standard models delayed to spring 2027.
All three new iPhones will use the A20 Pro chip built on a 2nm process, and price increases are expected due to memory shortages.
The foldable iPhone will feature a 5.5-inch closed and 7.6-inch open display, utilizing Touch ID instead of Face ID.
Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, new smart home devices, and software launch dates will also be presented.

title: WhatsApp strengthens two-step verification, adds enhanced call information
author: Vlad
content:
Today WhatsApp has announced some improved security features. First off, two-step verification is getting stronger. Before, it was a six-digit PIN. From now on, it will be a full password - longer, alphanumeric, and with special characters, making it harder to guess.
Next up, call security. When you pick up a call from someone who isn't in your contacts, you'll see more information about the caller, like whether their number is from a different country, or if you have any groups in common. This will help protect against scammers, hopefully. The bad news is that this feature is only coming to Android for now.
WhatsApp would also really like you to start using a passkey, which lets you log back into your account with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock code. WhatsApp says it's the "fastest and most secure way to verify it's really you, with no codes or PINs". More than a billion people have apparently already set one up, and you can now add more than one passkey to your account - which is useful if you use both Android and iOS devices, for example. Just go to Settings > Account > Passkeys.
What a joke. This is so-called bragging privacy only relatively related to user-user or user-swindler (in some cases). They (wassup) in-house collecting, reading, analyzing everything.
summary: WhatsApp has announced updates to its security features, including a stronger alphanumeric password option for two-step verification and enhanced call information for unknown numbers on Android. Additionally, users can now add multiple passkeys to their accounts for biometric login. These updates aim to improve account security and help users identify potential scammers.
key_points: Two-step verification now supports longer, alphanumeric passwords with special characters instead of just a six-digit PIN.
Android users will see enhanced caller information for unknown contacts, such as country origin and shared groups.
Users can now add multiple passkeys to their accounts for biometric verification using fingerprints, faces, or screen locks.
Over a billion people have already set up passkeys on WhatsApp.

title: ROG Xbox Ally X20 Gets Official Price: $300 Extra for a Bigger OLED Screen, TMR Sticks and Translucent Golden Chassis
author: Digital Foundry; William Judd
content:
![Asus Xbox Ally X20 price and release date](https://images.digitalfoundry.net/b57cf9693f77e/asus-xbox-ally-x20-price-and-release-date.970x.jpg)
The Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 caused a bit of a stir when it was announced back in June, as it crammed a larger 7.4-inch OLED screen into the Xbox Ally X, solving that handheld's only real weakness. It added some nice-to-haves too, including trendy TMR thumbsticks, MicroSD Express support and an exquisite semi-transparent chassis with golden details. The only issue is that it was intended to be a special Asus 20th anniversary limited edition bundled with expensive XR glasses - something that Asus is now revisiting.
In short, the ROG Xbox Ally X20 will be available as a proper standalone product, with an asking price of $1300. That's $300 more than the original Xbox Ally X handheld, but $700 cheaper than the similarly-OLED-equipped Lenovo Legion Go 2.
The UK pricing for the X20 is less favourable by comparison, with a £1300 price tag that means it comes at a steep £450 premium versus the original Xbox Ally X at £850.
You can also still pick up the X20 with ROG Xreal R1 Edition 20 XR glasses as intended, for a princely sum of $2500 or £2300. That bundle now comes with a dBrand Killswitch case to protect the handheld and a custom pelican case for the whole lot.
The standalone and bundle versions ship on October 15th, with pre-orders open now at the Asus US store and Best Buy. We'll update this article once the UK pre-orders are live.
Are you interested in the handheld, or are you holding all tech purchases while the AI-fuelled component crisis continues? Let me know in the comments below.
summary: The Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 will be released as a standalone handheld on October 15th for $1300, which is $300 more than the original Xbox Ally X. It features a larger 7.4-inch OLED screen, TMR thumbsticks, MicroSD Express support, and a semi-transparent golden chassis. In the UK, the device will cost £1300, and a bundle including XR glasses will also be available for $2500 or £2300.
key_points: The ROG Xbox Ally X20 standalone handheld is priced at $1300 in the US and £1300 in the UK.
It costs $300 more than the original Xbox Ally X.
Hardware upgrades include a 7.4-inch OLED screen, TMR thumbsticks, MicroSD Express support, and a translucent golden chassis.
A bundle featuring the X20 and ROG Xreal R1 Edition 20 XR glasses will cost $2500 or £2300.
Pre-orders are currently open, with shipping scheduled for October 15th.

title: GTA 6 leaks: Rockstar issues statement over online clips
author: Tom Richardson
content:
![Artwork from GTA 6 shows protagonists Jason and Lucia standing in front of a Miami-inspired skyline at sunset. The pair embrace while looking suspiciously at something or someone out of shot. Lucia rests one hand, holding a pistol, on Jason's chest.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/3840/cpsprodpb/91e8/live/3c295e10-a147-11f1-aed2-8d6da8d75094.jpg)
Grand Theft Auto 6 tells the story of lovers Lucia and Jason
- Published
Grand Theft Auto 6 maker Rockstar Games has issued a statement addressing a series of leaked videos showing the upcoming blockbuster video game.
Clips appearing to show gameplay and cinematics from the title began appearing online last week, but the developer did not acknowledge them straight away.
In a statement, the company said the leaks had been "heartbreaking" for the team working on the sequel, and that they were "not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time".
The company apologised for the delays in releasing official updates on the highly anticipated title, but vowed to "exceed" fans' expectations in a special preview airing on Netflix this week.
When leaks first began to surface, there was some doubt as to whether they were genuine.
But as the days went on, evidence mounted to suggest they were legitimate.
Copies of clips were quickly taken down from social media sites via copyright strikes, where the owner of a work can request its removal.
And, on Friday, Rockstar's parent company Take Two Interactive launched legal proceedings regarding the leaks in a New York court.
Rockstar acknowledged players had been waiting for it to address the leaked footage, and said it was "unfortunate the intended game experience may now be impacted by some spoilers".
It also thanked fans who sent messages of support over the past week, adding: "Your words have meant more to the team than you can imagine."
The group behind the leaks claims to be acting in the interests of players, accusing Rockstar of engaging in anti-consumer practices such as its decision not to release a disc version of GTA 6 at launch.
Not everyone is convinced, as each release of new material has invited viewers to send cryptocurrency "donations" to the user uploading them.
![A male character from GTA 6 in an open-collared shirt with slicked-back hair and sunglasses leans, arms folded, against the controls of a yacht as it coasts down a waterway flanked by skyscrapers. A road bridge opens in the distance as orange dawn light reflects of the glass fronts of the tall buildings. The computer-generated image is convincingly lifelike.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/3840/cpsprodpb/ce4f/live/a3eacca0-a147-11f1-b109-879e35c24276.jpg)
The game is set amid the underworld of Leonida, a fictional US state inspired by Florida
GTA 6, due to be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox consoles in November, is still expected to be the biggest video game launch of the decade.
The previous game in the series, GTA 5, also broke records when it came out in 2013 and has sold more than 200 million copies since.
Two official trailers for the sixth game have almost 500 million combined views on YouTube, and the Netflix "extended look" on Thursday is being marketed as an event by the streaming service.
Next month the company is due to appear at an employment tribunal in Scotland to defend itself against claims it illegally sacked a group of ex-employees for trying to form a union.
It strongly denies the accusations, and says the workers were fired on the grounds of gross misconduct.
![A footer logo for BBC Newsbeat. It has the BBC logo and the word Newsbeat in white over a colorful background of violet, purple and orange shapes. At the bottom a black square reading "Listen on Sounds" is visible.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/976/cpsprodpb/2e16/live/2c659f70-76bd-11f1-9510-1546718f668b.jpg)
summary: Rockstar Games released a statement addressing a series of leaked gameplay and cinematic videos for Grand Theft Auto 6, calling the incident heartbreaking. The developer and its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, took action by issuing copyright strikes and launching legal proceedings in a New York court. Despite the spoilers, the game remains on track for its release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox consoles in November.
key_points: Rockstar Games described the recent GTA 6 leaks as heartbreaking and stated it was not how they intended fans to see the game.
Take-Two Interactive launched legal proceedings in a New York court regarding the leaked footage, alongside copyright strikes to remove clips from social media.
The leakers solicited cryptocurrency donations while claiming to act in the interests of players.
GTA 6 is scheduled for release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox consoles in November.

title: PlayStation 5 blackout continued indefinitely as gamers to miss out on GTA 6
author: Tom Chapman
content:
![PlayStation 5 blackout continued indefinitely as gamers to miss out on GTA 6](https://resizer.ladbiblegroup.com/unsafe/rs:fit:3840:0:0:0/g:sm/q:70/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldS1pbWFnZXMuY29udGVudHN0YWNrLmNvbS92My9hc3NldHMvYmx0YmMxODc2MTUyZmNkOWYwNy9ibHRlYzZmMjY5YzFkZDI1MWVkLzZhOGQ1NzAyM2Q2ZmU3NjQ4YTRjNjEzNy9KYXNvbl9hbmRfTHVjaWFfcmV0cm9fVmljZV9jaXR5X2Nhcl9pbl9HVEFfNi5qcGc.webp)
Sony is still reeling from the fallout of axing physical games, with angry PlayStation players sticking to their word and powering forward with a PS5 blackout. While this was originally only supposed to cover a week, the once-loyal fandom has now vowed to extend it indefinitely.
2026 is a massive one for video games, with the big three of Microsoft, Nintendo, and Sony each celebrating their own exclusives. PlayStation is arguably entering the busiest period of the year with the September 15 release of Marvel's Wolverine and the Goliath of GTA VI on November 19.
PS5 blackout extended indefinitely
Although it was originally pencilled in as a week of protesting from August 23 to August 30, updated language reiterates that this is the 'minimum' that people should be turning away from their PS5s for.
The @DoesItPlay1 X account is one of the leading voices of the movement, stating: "Everyone is encouraged to go indefinitely until Sony change course. Pedal to the metal or we won't get anywhere!”
Advert
While GTA VI and Marvel's Wolverine are obviously the big ones on the horizon, the irate PlayStation community could also miss out on Control Resonant, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, and The Blood of Dawnwalker.
The crux of the argument is the move away from physical discs, although the boycott also blames the gaming giant for moving "further apart from its fan base."
Whether this will take a toll on Sony's bottom line remains to be seen, but clapping back at critics, Sony CFO Lin Tao previously told investors the company wasn't seeing "any impact on our business".
Sticking to his guns, Lao concluded: "As a result of the discontinuation of discs, we don't see that there will be any negative impact on our business. However, as I already said, the users, the players have attachments, and we have to think about how to respond to that feedback."
It's true that Sony's stocks actually leaped by around 3.2% in the aftermath of the announcement that it was axing physical discs.
READ MORE: 3 theories about the woman featured in the GTA 6 cover art that make a lot of sense
Players react to PS5 blackout
The PS5 blackout is causing a stir online, with gamers rallying together and promising they'll keep their consoles turned off for the foreseeable future. When Does It Play? posted the updated guidance, one player wrote: "I’ve already been going for nearly three weeks now. I will continue to do so. I decided to play my other consoles."
Another added: "Disconnected from PSN on my PS3 and PS5 yesterday. I will do the same on my Vita and stay off my phone. I am not going the indefinite route but I’ll support the cause this week. Hopefully makes a dent."
Others were less convinced that it'll work, with someone else musing: "Spoiler alert: Sony won't change course. it's still a good idea to send a strong message but yeah, unless a significant amount joins (25% of the install base, minimum) they'll stick to their strategy."
Another concluded: "Cry me a river and grow up. Even car music has gone digital. And guess what? I literally bought a couple of games from the PlayStation Store today. You can keep crying about digital games while the rest of us enjoy them."
Many were asking how many people are actively taking part in the blackout, but as those metrics are impossible to track, we'll likely never know how many have truly turned their backs on the Blue Team.
Topics: PlayStation, PlayStation 5, Sony
summary: PlayStation players have extended an ongoing PS5 blackout indefinitely in protest of Sony's decision to axe physical games. The boycott, initially planned for one week, could lead gamers to miss major upcoming releases such as GTA 6 and Marvel's Wolverine. While Sony CFO Lin Tao previously stated that the discontinuation of discs has not negatively impacted the business, players continue to debate the effectiveness and participation rate of the movement online.
key_points: PlayStation users have extended their console blackout indefinitely to protest Sony's removal of physical games.
The boycott risks causing players to miss major 2026 releases including GTA 6 and Marvel's Wolverine.
Sony CFO Lin Tao previously reported no negative business impact from the discontinuation of physical discs.
The exact number of participants in the blackout remains unknown and untrackable.
Public reaction among gamers is divided, with some supporting the protest and others skeptical of its impact or continuing to purchase digital games.

title: The Witcher 3 Remaster announced, coming soon as free for existing owners, while expansion Songs of the Past's revamped mechanics finally shown
author: Robert Purchese
content:
The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past - which is due to arrive 12 years after the base game was released - has finally been detailed in a debut trailer, but the surprise news is there's also a The Witcher 3 - Remastered edition coming that considerably overhauls the game, and it'll be a free upgrade for all existing owners of the game. Remastered comes on 29th September, and it's coming to Switch 2 and Battle.net for the first time.
Remastered also sounds like a considerable effort. It's been co-developed with a studio called Yigsoft, and not only does it offer visual and performance enhancements but gameplay has been revamped too, including, yes, combat. There are new finishers, new animations, and an adaptive camera. The skill tree has also been reimagined to offer more flexibility, and there's a transmogrification system, "immersive meditation" according to The Witcher 3 website, an expanded photo mode, cross-platform mod support and more.
![Cover image for YouTube video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/IGk17XQ7IrQ/hqdefault.jpg) The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered | Official Announcement Trailer
A trailer for Remastered showed "enhanced combat", "improved traversal and movement", "enhanced monster behaviours", "improved mount handling", as well as the new skill tree and transmog system for you gear, and some of the new finishers.
As well as all this, the two existing expansions for The Witcher 3 - Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone - are also free for all owners of the base game as of this evening, too.
As for the expansion, Song of the Past, this is our first look at it, showing the new continent region of Letten we'll be exploring, which looks like an overgrown forested fantasy land. We see Geralt tussling with a warped tree monster, and talking to the other tree monster we saw in the Songs of the Past artwork.
Perhaps most importantly, though, Geralt has a new weapon for the expansion, and it's a chain that looks a lot like Ciri's chain she uses in The Witcher 4 trailer - that's the link, it seems. It's also, CD Projekt Red said on stage, the same chain Geralt uses in The Witcher 1 trailer, by which I assume the studio means the chain Geralt wraps around the Striga Princess that he kills for Foltest at the beginning of the game. This moment is also in the Netflix adaptation of The Witcher; it's one of Andrzej Sapkowski's first Witcher short stories.
On The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past website, CD Projekt Red wrote: "With enhancements to visuals, performance, gameplay, and more through the Remastered upgrade, the idyllic land of Letten is yours to explore. But a dark secret lurks beneath the surface, and Geralt must overcome never-before-seen foes as he fights to overcome its long-dormant evil. More than his life is at stake though; across a story filled with choices and consequences, the fate of the entire land, and even Geralt's closest friendship, are also at risk."
![Cover image for YouTube video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/SB3siHVCHpY/hqdefault.jpg) The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past | Official Teaser Trailer
That friend, incidentally, is Dandelion, as suspected. Letten is Dandelion's homeland and its "steeped in rural tradition and full of buried secrets".
This is our first proper dose of Songs of the Past information since The Witcher 3 expansion was announced in May this year. All we knew about it then was that it starred Geralt, would be equivalent in size to the game's other expansions, was being co-developed by external studio Fool's Theory, and would release in 2027. Everything else about Songs of the Past - setting, timeframe, storyline - was speculation.
The expansion's existence is remarkable because of its proximity to The Witcher 3's original release. The Witcher 3 was released in 2015, and the two expansions that followed it - Heart of Stone, and Blood and Wine - were released more or less within a year of its arrival.
Since then, a lot has happened. CD Projekt Red moved wholesale onto another game project, Cyberpunk 2077, and all of the launch-related drama that entailed, and it has announced a new Witcher game in The Witcher 4, which is in full production at the moment for a 2028 release.
Much of the team that originally made The Witcher 3 has moved around or moved on, with the game's director in particular leaving CD Projekt Red under a cloud to make new studio Rebel Wolves and new game The Blood of Dawnwalker, which looks very promising and is imminent.
The question is, then, can Songs of the Past recapture the magic that made The Witcher 3 so special? We'll hopefully be able to partially answer this question after seeing the expansion at Gamescom this week. Stay tuned.
summary: CD Projekt Red has announced The Witcher 3 - Remastered, launching on September 29th as a free upgrade for existing owners that brings visual, performance, and gameplay overhauls. Additionally, the upcoming expansion Songs of the Past was detailed in a debut trailer, showcasing the new region of Letten and a release slated for 2027. The existing expansions, Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone, have also been made free for base game owners.
key_points: The Witcher 3 - Remastered releases on September 29th and is a free upgrade for current owners, bringing visual and gameplay enhancements including a revamped combat system and skill tree.
The Remastered edition will also debut on Switch 2 and Battle.net, and includes cross-platform mod support.
The upcoming expansion Songs of the Past, co-developed with Fool's Theory, is set in Dandelion's homeland of Letten and is scheduled for release in 2027.
Songs of the Past features a new weapon for Geralt, a chain connected to lore from the original game and short stories.
Existing expansions Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine are now free for all owners of the base game.

title: All Xbox and PC games announced at Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live
author: Alexander Cope
content:
![Gamescom](https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Je5NPJcY6Xs5Hd64LdkfwD.jpg) 
Gamescom 2026 has arrived, and it's bringing with it a tidal wave of exciting Xbox and PC game announcements, courtesy of its Opening Night Live ceremony.
The event has just concluded, so we're rounding up every major new game reveal, gameplay demonstration, cinematic trailer, and news update for upcoming games shown at the ceremony for your viewing convenience.
Where and how you can watch Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live
![gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/Zzvzt3IjNik/maxresdefault.jpg) 
To watch Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live or rewatch its VOD, you will have to tune into Gamescom's YouTube and Twitch channels.
All Xbox and PC games shown at Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live
Here is where you will find all the game announcements from Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live, with links to their trailers, short synopses of what they are, and what we know of their release dates, platforms, and more.
We'll be updating this post live as the event happens so be sure to keep refreshing to stay on top of the latest announcements.
Nodus Fall
![Nodusfall World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/I59kIiEDOMM/maxresdefault.jpg) 
The show kicks off with Nodus Fall, a new co-op action game produced by Genshin Impact creators, Hoyoverse. In this game, you and three other players take on the role of Weavers and set forth on a perilous journey to defeat mythical gods and monsters in a ruined world.
Rainbow Six Tactics
![Rainbow Six Tactics - Reveal Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/xKLtkPCetyg/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Rainbow Six Tactics is an XCOM-like tactics game where you dispatch the iconic Operators of the Rainbow Six franchise across the world to dispatch terrorist threats.
The game is set to release in 2027.
Gears of War: E-Day
![Gears of War: E-Day | Official Story Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/9csWVZCa7sY/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Gears of War: E-Day shows more cutscenes of its highly anticipated single-player campaign in a new cinematic trailer. This latest chapter in the iconic third-person shooter series launches exclusively on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Game Pass on October 6, 2026.
Ananta
![Ananta World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/5Zgfoqzgln4/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Ananta is an upcoming open-world urban RPG with an anime art style where the player must protect humanity from destruction by the forces of Chaos.
It showed off a new gameplay demo trailer at Gamescom, which confirms that the game will release on January 15, 2027, for PC, PlayStation 5, and mobile devices.
Silent Hill: Townfall
![SILENT HILL: Townfall | Cast Reveal Trailer (4K: EN/ESRB) | KONAMI - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/_7sndWVG-hg/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Next up we have a new, cryptic trailer for Silent Hill: Townfall, a new entry in the legendary survival horror series where the player must navigate through the island of St. Amelia to uncover dark mysteries and avoid getting killed by horrifying monsters.
Silent Hill: Townfall is set to release on September 24, 2026, for PC and PlayStation 5.
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
![Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Launch Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/ULLFxFm6vvk/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, an upcoming action-adventure game, shows off a new trailer of the main character struggling to survive and unravel the secrets of the Minotaur island.
This game is set to release on August 27, 2026, for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
Sea of Remnants
![Sea of Remnants | Gamescom 2026 - Official Gameplay Showcase - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/p_gr9gKLyJ4/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Sea of Remnants is an upcoming, free-to-play action-RPG where you roam the seas as puppetfolk pirates in search of glory and treasure.
The game is set to release in 2026 for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5, and it's latest gameplay trailer confirms that the game is open for pre-registering.
Crimson Desert
![Crimson Desert Enhanced - Official Announcement Trailer | gamescom ONL 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/c5-8FXNmyJs/maxresdefault.jpg) 
The hit open-world RPG, Crimson Desert, has announced a new Enhanced Edition, which will feature all of the game's post-launch updates, expanded voice-overs and subtitles, and new story moments.
The game is available for purchase on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
The Blood of Dawnwalker
![The Blood of Dawnwalker — Launch Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/vxfFoJu_98o/maxresdefault.jpg) 
The Blood of Dawnwalker, the upcoming open-world action-RPG made by former CD Projekt Red developers, has released a new launch trailer ahead of its September 3, 2026, release on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
In this game, you play as Coen, a Dawnwalker vampire struggling to control his hunger for human blood while protecting his family from evil vampires. You will explore a dark fantasy world, make tough choices, and battle enemies in visceral combat using vampiric powers.
Lofsong
![Lofsöng World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/WDF61yayn-w/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Lofsong is a brand new and strange puzzle-adventure game where you explore a post-apocalyptic Earth to uncover the last remnants of our fallen civilization without the aid of dialogue or a map.
Lofsong is currently scheduled to release on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
Tides of Annihilation
![Tides of Annihilation World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/50mDxXfWEZQ/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Tides of Annihilation is an upcoming character-action game based on Arthurian legend. Its latest trailer shows off more of its story and gameplay, where Gwendolyn must travel with the Knights of the Round Table on a quest to restore a ruined world to its former glory.
The game is set to release sometime in the future for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5 and is now available for wishlisting.
Mega Man: Dual Override
![Mega Man: Dual Override World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/v4xqYrsZseo/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Mega Man: Dual Override is a brand new entry in Capcom's classic side-scrolling Mega Man franchise, and we've gotten a glimpse of its gameplay in a new trailer as the iconic Blue Bomber once again strives to save the day from the evil Dr. Wily.
Mega Man: Dual Override is set to release in 2027 on Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch 1/2, and PlayStation 5.
Rayman Legends Retold
![Rayman Legends Retold World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/Ia1t_McxuRs/maxresdefault.jpg) 
The upcoming remake of the critically-acclaimed Rayman Legends shows off its insane platforming gameplay with a trailer showcasing its Macarena Music Level.
Rayman Legends Retold is set to launch on October 1, 2026, for Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch 1/2, and PlayStation 5.
Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
![Game of Thrones: War for Westeros World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/sGtJWLeBxug/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Game of Thrones: War for Westeros is an upcoming real-time strategy game based on the long-running Games of Thromes book series where you be commanding the setting's various faction to dominate the land in an epic single-player campaign or intense multiplayer PVP skirmishes.
Game of Thrones: War for Westeros is set to release in early 2027 for PC.
Control Resonant
![CONTROL Resonant - Altered State Trailer | Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/VwOJuJRCLGk/maxresdefault.jpg) 
The hack-and-slash follow-up to the critically acclaimed action-adventure game, Control, has released a new gameplay trailer showcasing more of its otherworldly setting and bombastic combat system set to music by the classic electronic band, The Prodigy.
Control Resonant is scheduled to release on September 24, 2026, for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
Exodus
![Exodus World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/wANI7b7G8yw/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Exodus is an upcoming action-adventure where you are tasked with exploring the galaxy for Celestial technology to help ensure mankind's future after they fled a dying Earth.
Its latest trailer showcases its third-person gunplay, sci-fi setting, and an intriguing party named Salt, who is literally an octopus riding a mech suit.
Exodus is set to release on April 7, 2027, for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
![Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons - Official Gameplay Reveal - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/pNw0sh481bA/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons is an upcoming third-person action game set within the universe of the legendary Dungeons & Dragons universe. This Gamescom trailer gives us a 6-minute extended gameplay demo how the player will wield the dark powers of a Warlock to explore the world and slay the monsters of the Forgotten Realms.
Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons is set to release in 2026 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
1001 Threads of Mizan
![1001 Threads of Mizan - Announce Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/KYZrPktxmn8/maxresdefault.jpg) 
1001 Threads of Mizan is a brand new, original 3-player co-op action game where the players must work together to defeat towering beasts and monsters in a world inspired by One Thousand and One Nights (a.k.a. Arabian Nights).
1001 Threads of Mizan is set to launch sometime in the future for Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch 1/2, and PlayStation 5.
Metro 2039
![METRO 2039 | Gameplay Trailer - Renegade - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/ua3WO3GNq2U/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Metro 2039, the latest entry in the grimdark Metro franchise, has revealed more of its gritty setting, its tough-as-nails survival gameplay in the first-person, and some of the horrifying men and monsters you will encounter in this post-apocalyptic world.
Metro 2039 is set to launch in February 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
Silver Palace - House of Greed
![Silver Palace: House of Greed Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/I3qw68V9rxY/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Silver Palace is an upcoming action-RPG where you play as a detective solving mysteries in a Victorian-like setting while battling ancient horrors and mysterious beings. It will also feature a survival horror-like multiplayer mode called House of Greed.
Silver Palace is set to release sometime in the future for PC and PlayStation 5.
Gravhounds
![GRAVHOUNDS – Official Announce Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/qXHqAupnvS8/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Gravhounds is a 4-player co-op action builder where you play as humanoid dogs fighting on hostile worlds to extract their resources and fight off any pesky aliens looking to stop your mining operations.
Gravhounds is set to release via early access in 2026 for Xbox Series X|S and PC.
No Law
![NO LAW | Official Gameplay Trailer | Gamescom ONL 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/xwLo92E_cM0/maxresdefault.jpg) 
No Law is a first-person shooter where you play as Grey Harker, an ex-soldier struggling to survive in a dangerous, dystopian cyber-noir city where no laws exist.
No Law is set to launch in 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
Cinder City
![Cinder City Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/hCDnR_YiK_U/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Cinder City is a new tactical shooter where the player must explore a ruined, near-future version of Seoul and protect humanity from ravenous monsters and maniacal villains.
Metro 2039 is set to launch in February 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5 and is now available for wishlisting.
ONTOS
![ONTOS - Gameplay Reveal Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/EXRJB73BDfM/maxresdefault.jpg) 
ONTOS is a new dark sci-fi adventure game made by the creators of classic horror games such as Amnesia: The Dark Descent and SOMA. In this game, you are exploring a repurposed moon hotel called Samsara to uncover your father's past while making sure you don't lose your mind as reality has begun fracturing within this hotel.
ONTOS is set to launch in 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5.
DUST: Origins
![DUST: Origins World Premiere Trailer | gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/GVVWa41WZQs/maxresdefault.jpg) 
DUST: Origins is a top-down action-horror game where you must fight to escape a prison platform before its inmates, security guards, and invading monsters murder you.
DUST: Origins is set to launch in 2027 for PC and has launched a Kickstarter campaign for players to help fund and improve the game's development.
Showa American Story
![Showa American Story - gamescom In-Game Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/IgKDlz6E95E/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Showa American Story is an upcoming action game set within an alternate version of America that's been reshaped by Japanese culture. In this game, you must fight to survive against hordes of gangs, zombies, and monsters in over-the-top hack-and-slash battles while partaking in insane mini-games to make a living in this absurd take on post-apocalyptic settings.
Showa American Story is set to launch in 2027 for PC and PlayStation 5.
Crazy Taxi World Tour
![Crazy Taxi: World Tour | Multiplayer First-Look - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/a3mF9zwozJk/maxresdefault.jpg) 
Crazy Taxi World Tour, the long-awaited sequel to Sega's classic Crazy Taxi racing game, has shown off its multiplayer gameplay in a crazy new trailer.
Crazy Taxi World Tour is set to launch in 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch 1/2, and PlayStation 5.
Turok Origins
![Turok: Origins - Story Trailer - YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/5JftjO0nlwc/maxresdefault.jpg) 
The classic dino-slaying shooter series, Turok, is back with a new AAA entry called Turok Origins. In this game, you will blast killer dinosaurs and reptilian villains with over-the-top weaponry while harvesting your enemies' DNA to become stronger.
Turok Origins is set to launch in Spring 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch 1/2, and PlayStation 5.
Path of Exile 2

title: Concern at impact of Â£162m science research "cuts"
author: Victoria Walton
content:
![A large white satellite is pointing up to blue skies.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/999/cpsprodpb/9317/live/81dfc040-9fce-11f1-aed2-8d6da8d75094.jpg)
Funding has been moved away from the Science and Technology Facilities Council, with fears it will impact facilities at Oxfordshire's science hubs.
- Published
Thousands of science jobs and the closure of world-leading research programmes could be at risk, according to an MP.
Didcot and Wantage MP, Olly Glover, whose constituency includes Milton Park, Culham and Harwell science parks, has called for a review of the decision to allocate funding away from the Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC).
With increasing running costs, it means the sector, which includes innovation in areas including defence and satellite technology, is facing a funding shortfall of Â£162m.
The government said funding was remaining flat in the current spending review but it is "committed to working to ensure the UK sustains its world-leading research capabilities."
UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) is the body responsible for allocating government funding from the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade.
This year's budget is Â£38.6 billion pounds, but according to the government, priorities have changed with more money now going towards things that "drive research that delivers real impact for the public."
It means funding has remained flat for the STFC - which includes research into particle physics, astronomy and nuclear physics.
An STFC spokesperson said, "faced with growing costs that will exceed available budgets over the next four years, we have to act now to avoid more serious disruption later."
![A man is wearing a smart blue suit and white shirt. He is standing next to a satellite, smiling.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/999/cpsprodpb/9056/live/3eb2ca60-9fce-11f1-a291-b542ee92de7c.jpg)
Executive director of the Royal Astronomical Society, Ian Russell, says the funding cuts will result in "huge risks" for Oxfordshire's science facilities.
What's at risk?
Nationally, it's led to the potential closure of the Jodrell Bank Observatory, home to the UK's largest telescope.
But what could the impact be in Oxfordshire?
Executive director of the Royal Astronomical Society, Ian Russell, said Oxfordshire's research hubs are now facing "huge risks", with some facilities facing 20%, 40% or 60% cuts "or even facing closure completely."
According to Russell, the ultra powerful microscope, the ISIS Neutron and Muon Source - based at Harwell Campus - is reducing its running time and there's a risk the team may "lose the Muon source altogether".
The device, based at Harwell Campus, can be used for things like developing new pharmaceuticals and improving battery technology.
An STFC spokesperson has rejected the idea, saying the microscope is still continuing to operating as normal "undertaking phenomenal research and supporting a community of very highly skilled staff who are expert engineers, scientists and researchers."
![A sign reads "Welcome, Harwell". It is yellow, blue, white and black and positioned on the ground.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/999/cpsprodpb/1670/live/2022ffc0-9fce-11f1-b109-879e35c24276.jpg)
Harwell Science Campus is home to world leading scientific research.
Local MP, Olly Glover, is also concerned about potential jobs cuts at Oxfordshire's science hubs.
"Multidisciplinary scientific research is crucial to driving economic growth. These funding cuts threaten thousands of jobs across Oxfordshire and the UK, impacting many of our constituents," he said.
There are also fears about the impact on international relations with scientists across the world.
Russell said the cuts were a "drop in the ocean" for UKRI, but risked undermining the UK as "trusted partners in international collaboration."
"We're talking about sciences that the UK is already a world leader and there's plenty of research that says the funding that goes into that research and development has a massively beneficial impact on the economy."
"For every Â£1 spent on fundamental research we get about Â£8 back for the economy, so it's actually great value to UK PLC," he said.
In a letter to Jonathan Reynolds, the secretary of state for business, innovation, science and trade and co-signed by Conservative and Labour MPs, Glover said the cuts threaten world leading scientific research and job opportunities for young people.
"Ultimately, our scientific leadership on the world stage, higher education sector and skills pipeline are all currently at risk of being irreparably damaged. Now is the time to prevent that from happening," he said.
A government spokesperson said, "we are not cutting the STFC budget: it is remaining flat over the course of the current spending review. To ensure we can drive research that delivers real impact for the public, we are funding R&D at record levels, including Â£38.6 billion invested in UKRI over the coming years."
"UKRI is responsible for taking specific funding decisions, but we are committed to working to ensure the UK sustains its world-leading research capabilities."
summary: Funding reallocations away from the Science and Technology Facilities Council have created a £162m shortfall, raising concerns among MPs and researchers about potential job losses and facility closures. While the government stated that the STFC budget is remaining flat amid record overall R&D investment, experts warn that the shortfall threatens world-leading research and international scientific collaborations. Oxfordshire's science hubs and national facilities like the Jodrell Bank Observatory face significant risks of reduced running times or closure.
key_points: A £162m funding shortfall is impacting the Science and Technology Facilities Council due to flat funding and rising running costs.
Local MP Olly Glover has called for a review, warning that thousands of science jobs and research programmes are at risk.
Experts warn that Oxfordshire science hubs and national sites like the Jodrell Bank Observatory face severe cuts or potential closure.
The government stated that the STFC budget is remaining flat while overall UKRI funding reaches £38.6 billion to drive public impact.

title: WhatsApp tightens account security with stronger two-step verification and more | TechCrunch
author: Aisha Malik
content:
WhatsApp announced Tuesday that it’s launching new security features and updates to help users keep their accounts secure, including stronger two-step verification and the ability to add more than one passkey to your account. The Meta-owned app is also adding context to calls from unknown numbers.
The updates come as WhatsApp and other messaging apps, such as Signal and Telegram, look to make account security easier and more accessible for everyday users, especially as phishing and hacking attempts have become more sophisticated over the years.
Until now, WhatsApp’s two-step verification has used a six-digit PIN as an extra layer of protection to prevent someone from taking over an account even if they’re able to obtain the user’s one-time passcode. Now, users can choose a longer, alphanumeric password with special characters to make the PIN harder to guess.
As for passkeys, users can now add more than one passkey to their account, which WhatsApps says will be useful if a person uses both iOS and Android.
![](https://techcrunch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image_0acc47.png?w=680)
Passkeys, which WhatsApp launched support for in 2024, are far stronger than passwords and allow users to log in to their accounts using Face ID or their fingerprint. Passkeys remove the need to rely on username and password combinations, which are ordinarily susceptible to phishing attacks. Passkey logins make it harder for bad actors to remotely access your accounts, as an attacker would need physical access to a person’s device that stores the user’s part of the passkey.
Additionally, Android users will now see more information when they’re getting a call from someone who isn’t in their contacts, like whether the number is from a different country and if they have any groups in common with the caller.
The latest features join the growing list of updates WhatsApp has rolled out in recent months. The company launched usernames in late June to allow people to share their profiles without disclosing their phone number. In late May, Meta launched a subscription plan for the messaging app that unlocks extra features, like profile customization, super reactions, story insights, and more.
The WhatsApp Plus plan launched alongside similar “Plus” offerings for Instagram and Facebook.
summary: WhatsApp is rolling out new security features, including stronger alphanumeric two-step verification and support for multiple passkeys to make accounts more secure against phishing. The Meta-owned app is also providing Android users with more context when receiving calls from unknown numbers. These updates arrive alongside other recent platform additions, such as usernames and a paid WhatsApp Plus subscription plan.
key_points: WhatsApp users can now choose longer, alphanumeric passwords with special characters for two-step verification.
Users are now able to add more than one passkey to their account, which is useful for people using both iOS and Android.
Android users will now see additional information, such as country origin and mutual groups, when receiving calls from unknown numbers.
WhatsApp recently launched usernames in June to let users share profiles without disclosing their phone numbers.

title: Here’s When Apple Will Reveal Its iPhone 18 Pro And Foldable Phone Date
author: David Phelan
content:
Apple is about to take the first public step in a journey that will end with the on-sale date for the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and the company’s first foldable, whatever that turns out to be called. Here are the moments to look out for and you can read a full run-down of the expected schedule here.
Apple iPhone 18 Pro: Here Comes The Keynote
Apple will confirm its September special event any minute now. To be precise, I believe the announcement will come on Wednesday, Aug. 26, likely around 10 a.m. Pacific, 1 p.m. Eastern and 6 p.m. U.K.
Apple will do this by sending out invites to members of the press and special guests, undoubtedly with a cryptic phrase and image which everyone can have fun trying to decode. I’ll update this post as soon as that happens, so please check back.
Invites for the keynote will reveal exactly when and where the iPhone announcement will take place.
Apple iPhone 18 Pro: The Keynote Date
That will be, I believe, on Wednesday, Sept. 9, exactly two weeks after the invites are sent out. Almost to the minute, in fact, because the keynote will start at 10 a.m. Pacific, 1 p.m. Eastern and 6 p.m. U.K.
It will take place in the Steve Jobs Theater in Apple Park, the company’s Cupertino, California HQ.
Even Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, who has said Sept.8 could be the date, seems to be coming round to my opinion. “Later this week, Apple is poised to send out invitations for its iPhone launch presentation. That event, which is likely to be held on Sept. 9, will introduce the company’s first foldable smartphone, as well as the iPhone 18 Pro line,” he said.
Apple iPhone 18 Pro: The Keynote Details
Unless there’s a break with tradition, the keynote will last anywhere between one and two hours and is likely to take this format.
It will begin with a live introduction from the stage by the Apple CEO who will, for the first time, be John Ternus, having taken the reins from Tim Cook on Tuesday, Sept. 1. Cook will become Apple’s Executive Chairman.
After the introduction, Apple will screen its keynote movie, a high-production-quality affair with special effects and every detail of each new product.
It’s possible there will be more live elements than before, perhaps as a way for Ternus to indicate that things are changing while still showing continuity.
As well as the iPhones, expect the event to reveal two new Apple Watches. There had been rumors of new Macs, but Apple announced those on Tuesday, Aug. 25 — full details here.
The keynote is when we’ll learn what the new iPhone will look like, and whether it’s changed size compared to last year’s model.
Apple iPhone 18 Pro: The On-Sale Date
Unless there’s an upheaval to the timetable, Apple will put the new phones on sale on the Friday of the week after the keynote, which means the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and the first foldable iPhone will land in stores on Friday, Sept. 18.
summary: Apple is expected to send out media invitations for its upcoming September special event on August 26. The keynote event is anticipated to take place on September 9 at the Steve Jobs Theater, where the iPhone 18 Pro line, Apple's first foldable smartphone, and new Apple Watches will be revealed. New products, including the new iPhones and the foldable device, are expected to go on sale on September 18.
key_points: Press invitations for the September event are expected to be sent out on Wednesday, August 26.
The keynote event is predicted for Wednesday, September 9, at the Steve Jobs Theater in Apple Park.
The presentation is expected to introduce the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple's first foldable phone, and two new Apple Watches.
John Ternus is expected to host the keynote introduction in his new role as Apple CEO.
The new devices are projected to go on sale in stores on Friday, September 18.

title: PS Plus September 2026: Predictions, Leaks And Reveal Date
author: Erik Kain
content:
Post updated 08/25/26. See updates below.
September is almost here and with it another slate of free PS Plus games for Sony fans. We’ve had some quality lineups across 2026, so hopefully that trend continues and September’s PS Plus Essential Games are keepers.
You have a week left to snag August’s PS Plus Essential games: Dying Light 2: Stay Human, Signalis (a PS4 title) and the hit indie game, Big Walk (with a 93 Metacritic score, making it one of the best-reviewed games of the year when it comes to PS Plus freebies). Despite this being a pretty good month, plenty of PS Plus subscribers were unhappy with the offerings, but that’s true of pretty much every month.
August has been a good month for PS Plus subscribers. On August 18, Vampire Survivors, Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, and Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams came to PS Plus Extra. On August 25, PS Plus Extra subscribers get Hell is Us, Umamusume Pretty Derby: Party Dash, Two Point Museum, Metro Exodus, and, as luck would have it, Dying Light 2.
For the purposes of this post, we’ll be focusing on September’s three Essential games including leaks, rumors, reveal time, release date and more.
When Will Sony Reveal September’s PS Plus Games Lineup?
![frase](https://images.forbes.com/fbs-games-assets/frase.png)
FEATURED | Frase ByForbes™
Unscramble The Anagram To Reveal The Phrase
![pinpoint](https://images.forbes.com/fbs-games-assets/pinpoint.png)
Pinpoint By Linkedin
Guess The Category
![queens](https://images.forbes.com/fbs-games-assets/queens.png)
Queens By Linkedin
Crown Each Region
![crossclimb](https://images.forbes.com/fbs-games-assets/crossclimb.png)
Crossclimb By Linkedin
Unlock A Trivia Ladder
Sony typically reveals the upcoming PS Plus Essential lineup on the last Wednesday of the month and releases the new games on the first Tuesday of the coming month. That’s not always the case, but it’s a good rule of thumb.
This means that September's PS Plus Essential games get announced August 26 and go live September 1, with Extra and Premium’s first wave revealed September 9 and dropping on September 15.
This means there’s only a six-day gap between the reveal and the drop, because September 1 is itself the first Tuesday of the month. It also means August's Dying Light 2, Big Walk, and Signalis — all very much worth downloading if you’re a PS Plus subscriber — expire August 31. Don’t sleep on these games!
PS Plus September 2026 Games Leaked
Update: The September lineup of PS Plus games just leaked online, a day before the official announcement. The leak comes by way off billbil-kun at Dealabs, who has accurately leaked countless PS Plus lineups prior to their official reveal. The games for September reportedly include Sniper Elite: Resistance, Chained Echoes, and Wobbly Life. None of these were in my own predictions, unfortunately. Billbil-kun has an exceptionally strong track record with PlayStation Plus leaks, accurately revealing monthly games ahead of Sony’s official announcements for years. While no leak should be treated as official confirmation, his PS Plus reports have historically been highly reliable. We’ll know for sure when Sony reveals the lineup officially.
- Sniper Elite: Resistance has a Mostly Positive user review score on Steam. It’s a third-person stealth-and-snipe shooter that takes place in WWII France during the Nazi occupation.
- Chained Echoes is a 16-bit style JRPG set in a fantasy world “where dragons are as common as piloted mechanical suits.” It’s a modern take on the turn-based NES classics of old and has a Very Positive user review score on Steam.
- Wobbly Life rounds out these wildly different titles and gives you something to play with friends. The co-op game is all about playing together in vibrant sandbox worlds, building stuff and solving puzzles, playing mini-games and upgrade your vehicles and houses. It has an Overwhelmingly Positive user review score on Steam.
The games will release on Tuesday, September 1. Be sure to download August’s free PS Plus Essential lineup before it’s too late!
[Original Story]
So far there have been no reliable leaks for September's PS Plus lineup. If one arrives, it'll almost certainly come from billbil-kun at Dealabs, who has been the most accurate PS Plus leaker going for years now and who typically posts the month's headline title anywhere from one to seven days before Sony's reveal. That gives us a narrow window: the official announcement is expected Wednesday, August 26, though Sony jumped a day early last month so it’s always possible the reveal could come sooner.
We can also look at what’s coming out to see if we can glean any clues, but here again we come up mostly dry. No video games appear to be releasing on September 1, but Trine 6 comes out on September 17 and I’ve had Trine 5 on my wishlist for sometime now. That’s something!
If we look back at previous years, past September releases are also very little help.
Previous September PS Plus Essential Lineups
Looking back at the PS Plus September lineup over the last seven years, it’s hard to really come up with any coherent theme. Here’s what we’ve gotten since 2019:
2019 — Batman: Arkham Knight, Darksiders III
2020 — PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds, Street Fighter V
2021 — Overcooked! All You Can Eat, Predator: Hunting Grounds, Hitman 2
2022 — Granblue Fantasy: Versus, Need For Speed Heat, Toem
2023 — Saints Row (2022), Black Desert Traveler Edition, Generation Zero
2024 — Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions, MLB The Show 24, Little Nightmares II
2025 — Psychonauts 2, Stardew Valley, Viewfinder
Basically, there’s no telling what September will bring. Sometimes we get horror games (a little early for Halloween) and the occasional sports title. Some indie stuff. A couple of racing games. It’s really an anything goes!
A raft of PS Plus Extra games (and a couple Premium) titles will leave the service in mid-September, including: Persona 5 Tactica, Shadowrun Returns, Shadowrun Hong Kong: Extended Edition, Shadowrun Dragonfall: Director's Cut, Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIII, Toukiden 2, Bubsy: The Woolies Strike Back, EA Sports Madden NFL 26, and — on Premium — Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue and Toy Story 3.
It’s unlikely that any of these will come to Essential the same month they leave Extra or Premium, but we could get something to fill the void — a JRPG perhaps.
My 3 Predictions For September PS Plus
Spider-Man 2 — The headliner for September riding on the coattails of the massive success of Spider-Man: Brand New Day. It’s a popular game and there’s no better time than striking while the iron is hot. Besides, the new Wolverine game comes out in September, so this would be a pleasant pairing.
Trine 5 — The indie title of the list. The little guy, but a great fun co-op fantasy game you can play with friends. Might be too soon to the next game’s release, however. But I want an indie title in my predictions trio and this is what I’m going with!
Stellar Blade — Shift Up is working on the sequel, Blood Rain, and there’s no better way to drive a little hype than with a free PS Plus release of the original action game. Of course, the sequel is still a long ways out, but Stellar Blade has been out long enough to make sense on PS Plus regardless.
Now, onto the wishlist!
PS Plus September 2026 PS Plus Wishlist
Some of these are more likely candidates than others and some of these are quite obviously just wishful thinking. Most of these remain from past prediction lists, since they haven’t been picked yet!
Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered — This is a modern classic open-world adventure game about fighting giant robotic dinosaurs in a post-apocalyptic future. It seems like the perfect candidate for a PS Plus title, since the remaster came out two years ago.
Atomfall — The first-person survival-action game set in an alternate-history 1960s Britain after a nuclear disaster is a top pick for a lot PS Plus hopefuls. It only released in early 2025, however, so it’s pretty new for a PS Plus inclusion. Then again, we’ve seen quicker turnarounds (Dragon Age: The Veilguard for instance).
Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition — Two reasons for this. One, there’s an Anniversary Edition out and the second season of Amazon’s excellent Fallout series has renewed interest in the series.
Dispatch — An absolutely wonderful interactive movie style superhero game that blends gorgeous animation and incredible writing and acting with a fun superhero management sim.
Kingdom Come: Deliverance — The excellent Medieval RPG is many years old now, and the sequel just came out. Why not release the original on PS Plus? Well...I guess because it was a PS4-era game. But they could release the sequel!
Blue Prince — One of my favorite games of 2025, this would make a great indie title to go with some bigger releases. What an absolute gem.
Resident Evil 4 Remake — The remake of the popular action-horror game from 2005 was released in 2023 to wide acclaim. It’s old enough to be a contender for a PS Plus release and would definitely be a crowd-pleaser.
Elden Ring — FromSoftware’s mega-hit action-RPG would be a huge win for Sony and PlayStation Plus gamers. Even Demon’s Souls Remake would be a massive win, though I put both of these in the “wishful thinking” column. Still, Elden Ring might make sense given the recent release of the standalone multiplayer spinoff Nightreign.
Star Wars Outlaws — Ubisoft’s open-world Star Wars game wasn’t the hit they needed, but it’s still a pretty fun way to head to a galaxy far, far away and rub shoulders with scum and villainy. It would make a really perfect PS Plus release.
Death Stranding — Hideo Kojima’s weirdest game was a big enough hit to commission a sequel and that sequel just came out in 2025. Makes sense to get the original onto PS Plus at some point, if only to drive more people to the newer (and more expensive) sequel.
Street Fighter 6 — The popular fighting game franchise continues to be a crowd-pleaser, and releasing this 2023 game on PS Plus would be fun despite getting a fighting game last month. That makes me doubtful we’ll see this one, but I’d play it if Sony put it out there.
Squirrel with a Gun — As the title indicates, this is a little game where you play as a squirrel with a gun. It’s the kind of indie title that often accompanies bigger, AAA releases in a PS Plus lineup.
Assassin’s Creed Mirage — Releasing a free Assassin’s Creed game makes sense with the Black Flag remake on the horizon. Get people excited about the re-release. It’s already been added to Extra and Premium, of course.
(Prediction Now!) Trine 5 — I used to absolutely love the Trine games. I remember playing them with my kids when they were little. The gorgeous artwork in those games plus the couch co-op just made them such a delight. Then I forgot about them, and I actually never did play the fifth game. I’d love to, though. It would be super nostalgic for the whole family. Here’s hoping!
All The PS Plus Essential Games Released In 2026
Here’s what we’ve nabbed so far.
January 2026
- Need for Speed Unbound
- Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
- Core Keeper
February 2026
- Undisputed
- Subnautica: Below Zero
- Ultros
- Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown
March 2026
- PGA Tour 2K25
- Monster Hunter Rise
- Slime Rancher 2
- The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road Collection
April 2026
- Lords of the Fallen
- Tomb Raider 1-3 Remastered
- Sword Art Online: Fractured Daydream
May 2026
- EA Sports FC 26
- Nine Sols
- Wuchang: Fallen Feathers
June 2026
- Grounded: Fully Yoked Edition
- Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
- Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
July 2026

- For the King II
- CrossCode
August 2026
- Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition (PS4, PS5)
- Big Walk (PS5, day one)
- Signalis (PS4)
PS Plus Current Pricing
US PlayStation Plus pricing as of now:
- Essential — $10.99/month, $27.99/quarter, $79.99/year
- Extra — $16.99/month, $43.99/quarter, $134.99/year
- Premium — $19.99/month, $54.99/quarter, $159.99/year
PS Plus pricing went up earlier this year. Sony announced the increase on May 18, 2026, effective for new customers from May 20 — Essential, Extra and Premium climbed to $10.99, $16.99 and $19.99 monthly, with the three-month options rising to $27.99, $43.99 and $54.99.
Interestingly, annual plans were not raised, holding at $79.99, $134.99 and $159.99, and remain at their pre-hike rates as of August 2026. This is a departure from the September 2023 price hike, which jacked up both annual and monthly prices at the same time.
What games would you like to see come to PS Plus this September? Any insights or predictions? Any leaks I should know about? Let me know on Twitter or Facebook. Also be sure to subscribe to my YouTube channel and follow me here on this blog. You can also sign up for my Substack newsletter, Diabolical, where I talk culture and politics and the arts.

title: City Builder LEGO Skylines Announced for PS5, and It Seems Like a Perfect Match

content:

Publisher Paradox Interactive has just announced LEGO Skylines, and it's confirmed for PS5.

If you ask me, a LEGO city builder seems like the perfect fit of genre and licence.

title: NBA 2K27 Is Teasing a GTA 6-Themed Event in Collaboration with Rockstar Games
author: Cade Onder
content:
NBA 2K27 is teasing a crossover with Rockstar Games, seemingly to promote Grand Theft Auto 6.
At the end of the trailer for NBA 2K27 Season 1, there's a very cryptic tease. The camera tilts down toward a purple-ish poster sporting palm trees, which looks awfully similar to the very first artwork Rockstar released for GTA 6. Seagulls and police sirens can be heard in the background before the camera pans over to an arcade cabinet. One machine has the 2K logo and the other has the Rockstar Games logo. On the screens, the words "Season 3" can be seen in the GTA 6 font and color scheme.
Seasons tend to last about six weeks, so we can expect Season 3 to launch around the time of GTA 6's release in November. It's unclear what exactly this will offer, especially since NBA 2K is an E-rated game and the GTA series pushes the boundaries with its M-ratings. However, it appears to be part of a larger effort to ramp up marketing for what will undoubtedly be one of the biggest releases in entertainment history.
A lot of fans have been frustrated with the lack of marketing for GTA 6 up until now. There have been two trailers and some screenshots to go along with pre-orders, but that's about it as of right now. However, things will ramp up later this week when Rockstar Games releases an extended look at the game on Netflix. Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick previously teased a big marketing campaign for GTA 6, and it seems like the decision to partner with Netflix and Take-Two's other juggernaut franchise, NBA 2K, will help emphasize the significance of this release.
Maybe players will be able to rep Vice City-themed gear or maybe there will be a Vice City basketball court in NBA 2K27. Basketball appears to be a part of GTA 6, as recently revealed in leaked gameplay for the title, but it's unclear how big of a role that mini-game will play in GTA 6. Either way, all will be revealed in the coming months.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.
summary: NBA 2K27 has teased a crossover with Rockstar Games to promote the upcoming release of Grand Theft Auto 6. The trailer for NBA 2K27 Season 1 featured subtle references including a palm tree poster, audio cues, and arcade cabinets displaying "Season 3" in the GTA 6 font and color scheme. This collaboration is part of a broader marketing push for GTA 6, which also includes an upcoming extended look on Netflix.
key_points: NBA 2K27's Season 1 trailer included cryptic teases hinting at a Grand Theft Auto 6 crossover for Season 3.
The teaser featured palm tree visuals, police sirens, seagulls, and arcade cabinets with the Rockstar Games logo.
Season 3 is expected to launch around November, coinciding with the anticipated release of GTA 6.

title: WhatsApp announces three ways to make accounts more secure - 9to5Mac
author: Marcus Mendes
content:
![](https://9to5mac.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2026/08/whatsapp-security.jpg?quality=82&strip=all&w=1600) 
Meta today announced a set of new security features for WhatsApp, including expanded passkey support and stronger two-step verification. Here are the details.
WhatsApp announces account security features
Meta today announced that WhatsApp now supports more than one passkey for the same account, a welcome feature for users who use both iOS and Android devices.
WhatsApp says more than 1 billion people now use passkeys to log back into their accounts with Face ID, Touch ID, or a screen lock code. The company first introduced passkey support on Android in October 2023 and expanded it to iPhone the following April.
Additionally, WhatsApp announced today that its two-step verification feature is expanding beyond a six-digit PIN to support full alphanumeric passwords, including special characters.
As WhatsApp explains, “two-step verification is an extra protection layer that helps prevent someone from taking over your account, even if they get hold of your one-time passcode,” and you can learn more about that here.
Finally, alas, this last feature is only available on Android for now, WhatsApp is adding a feature designed to make calls from unknown contacts safer to pick up.
From the press release:
When you get a call from someone not saved in your contacts, a little context can help you decide whether to pick up. On Android, you’ll now see more information about a non-contact caller, like whether the number is from a different country and if you have any groups in common. Scammers rely on urgency – now you can take a beat with some more info before answering.
It is worth mentioning that iPhone users can rely on a similar feature for traditional phone calls. Apple’s Call Screening feature, available on iPhones running iOS 26, automatically asks unknown callers for their name and reason for calling before the iPhone rings. Although it does not work with WhatsApp calls, you can learn more about it here.
To learn more about the security features WhatsApp announced today, follow this link.
